description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named MerchantStoreController responsible for handling administrative operations related to Merchant Stores within an e-commerce system. It provides methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, checking, and removing merchant stores, along with auxiliary functions such as setting up menus and sending notification emails.

classes.name: MerchantStoreController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing CRUD and administrative operations for Merchant Stores

methods.name: displayStores
methods.description: Handles GET request to list merchant stores, setting the menu and returning the store listing view.

methods.name: pageStores
methods.description: Handles POST request for pagination of store list, returning JSON with store summaries.

methods.name: displayMerchantStoreCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the store creation form, initializing a new MerchantStore object.

methods.name: displayMerchantStore
methods.description: Handles GET requests to view or edit existing or new store details, preparing the model with necessary data.

methods.name: saveMerchantStore
methods.description: Processes POST request to save or update store data, including validation, email notification, and session update.

methods.name: checkStoreCode
methods.description: Validates whether a given store code already exists, responding with JSON status.

methods.name: removeMerchantStore
methods.description: Handles POST request to logically delete a store, with security checks ensuring only authorized users can perform this operation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method for setting the menu context in the model for rendering views.
